entries.title: Play-test fixes
items: Markets, paddocks, docks, gardens and farms no longer get "lost" for nothing. When a building really is lost, the message says why: fire, enemies, or it was knocked down.
The game no longer drops back to 1x or blows the horn over and over just because a creature wanders near town. Only a real raid or army does that.
Fire and other world sounds only play when they happen on screen, so a far-off wildfire stays quiet.
Wildfires far from your towns spread more slowly and burn out sooner, and big ones bring rain clouds.
The build list and other long lists turn pages instead of running off the screen.
While you place a building or draw a road or wall, the panel shrinks to one slim strip so you can see the map.
Tap a found resource (the square in a dotted ring) or a monster lair (the dark square with a red rim) to see what it is. Resources get a 'Build a mine here' button, and lairs can be hidden in Views.

Raids say which direction they come from, and a red ring marks where they will appear. A ⚔ counter shows enemies near your towns (tap it to look), and arrows at the screen edge point at any you can't see.
The globe snaps in and out instead of fading, and its lit side faces you. At night the whole globe dims and town lights glow.
Fountains have water in them.
Report a problem is in the ☰ menu now, and opening the menu pauses the game.
Towns no longer pave lakes and bays with plank bridges. Streets stay on land and only bridge small streams.
The ⚔ enemy counter moved off the top bar to the row below it, and the top bar now fits on a phone, so the speed button is always on screen.

entries.title: A kingdom that runs itself
items: Land anywhere on the globe and found your keep; settlers arrive and build their own homes along your roads.
Homes climb from tents to manors as their needs are met, and neighbours merge into bigger houses.
Find iron, coal, gold and crystals in the hills, build mines on them, and carts bring the goods home.
Workshops turn logs, ore, grain, wool and gold into planks, iron, bread, ale, cloth, furniture and jewellery.
Draw walls with towers and gates; they crack, fall and get repaired. Fire stations and neighbours fight fires.
Hire guards, post them or draw patrol loops — they answer trouble on their own. Magic towers need no crew.
Wolves, trolls, the restless dead, drakes, bandits and raiders come for you. Rival kingdoms may be friends or foes.
Seven ruler powers paid in faith, trains between your towns, milestones with landmarks to raise, and achievements.

entries.title: A whole world
items: Make a world in six sizes, from X-tiny to X-large.
The map wraps all the way around; zoom out and it becomes a spinning globe.
Turn on 'Good places to settle' to see where a kingdom could start.
